newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Three more Sammi units seek court receivership.
newsitem.headline: Three more Sammi units seek court receivership.

text.p: South Korea's Sammi Group said on Friday its three remaining affiliates have filed for court receivership.
Sammi Metal Products Co, Sammi Technology and Industries Co and Sammi Fine Ceramics Co on Thursday filed for receivership, the group's spokesman Hwang Chul-gyu said.
Sammi Steel Co, South Korea's largest specialty stainless steel products maker, and its trading affiliate Sammi Corp filed for court receivership on Tuesday.
Later the two companies defaulted on repayments of promissory notes and their bank cheque-book accounts were frozen, bank and group officials said.
